findings.summary: request-excluded canary hits make search_text controls self-cancelling and base64 resource blobs invisible; need disjoint pattern and witness tokens, decoded-blob scan, and synthetic tests of both D5 clauses
controls do not hit the deny case's target canary (D01/M04, D02/M05, D11, D12); define target_domain per deny and same-canary same-tool controls
nonce sha256(case_id) collides between main and teeth D01, giving a deterministic false server_seen; key by (phase, case_id) and use file-direct stderr
max_leases_per_principal 1 makes R1 fail LEASE_CAPACITY after W1 and races M08/M09 on one lease; raise to 3 with graph leases 8 and use separate warm leases
outcome classifier unspecified and frozen expected_outcomes may include OTHER, so any error counts as typed denial; specify classifier order and ban OTHER in deny expectations
AC-002 teeth cover only the acquire condition; add a wrong-expectation negative control and a copy-namespace corruption that must fail the server-side conditions
sequential phases estimate 130-150 s against a 150 s recorder deadline and 120 s gate; measure under --cpus 4, set deadlines at least 2x, consider overlapping independent phases

interruption mechanics: running_jobs vs interrupted_jobs for job ids, cancel_sigterm needs release and S41 uses staged, stdin pipe held, env hygiene, Day-1 (d) must replay the D6 sequence for all eight injections, normalize kill exit codes

compat: read negotiated from the initialize response, send the negotiated header afterwards, literal oracle, SDK http_client Day-1 evidence, derive shared in the aggregator, negative controls must use never-cut units
capacity: peak<=limit is tautological, bound retries, declare capacity grants, optional deterministic gate-503 phase; saturation route itself is deterministic
gate peak>=3 does not prove holds were admitted; add a settle delay and word the overlap claim and recorder-attested holds_spanned precisely
aggregator robustness: typed errors for bad gzip/json/shape, failed records without body, input sha over strip(record), compare canonical plain bytes not gz bytes, unique importlib module name
subprocess.run timeout kills only the recorder and orphans servers; use start_new_session plus killpg, a reaper, and timeouts on every test subprocess
wording: precise ready regex, BANNED words, isolation means enumerated cases, no real host tested
lint and production-image runnability confirmed with checks: ruff/mypy via cwd config, atlas/evals unlinted acceptable, -I recorder with path-loaded siblings, P0 version checks
